brand.name: Clipwell
brand.personality: Confident infrastructure company that believes it is inventing a category nobody asked for.

tagline: The last stapler you'll ever have to onboard.

hero.headline: Document adhesion, finally solved.
hero.subhead: Clipwell is the fastening layer for teams who ship on paper. One device, zero downtime, and a scratch on the top plate that we consider a changelog.

features.title: Provenance built in
features.body: Every unit ships with a half-peeled asset tag. Not a defect — an immutable audit trail you can feel with your thumb.

features.title: Asymmetric wear telemetry
features.body: One side fades faster than the other. That gradient is data: it tells you which desk actually does the work.

features.title: Audible feedback loop
features.body: The hinge squeaks on every actuation. Competing solutions fail silently. Clipwell tells you it is alive.

testimonials.quote: We were fastening documents with three vendors and a prayer. Clipwell consolidated our stack down to one object that sits on a desk.
testimonials.author: Dana Reisch

testimonials.quote: The scratch on the top plate is how I know it's ours. You can't buy that kind of identity.
testimonials.author: Marcus Oyelaran

cta.headline: Join the teams who stopped thinking about staples.
cta.footnote: Clipwell is currently in limited release. The hinge is a feature and we will not be taking questions.
